title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.00948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using withi

translated_title: GUI-HARVEST：通过证据驱动的执行框架演化实现自我改进的GUI智能体
translated_abstract: GUI模型周围的可执行框架决定了观测如何组装、动作如何执行，以及验证、恢复和终止如何被控制。与针对非GUI智能体的框架优化相比，自动优化这一框架面临三个相互耦合的挑战：协调模型意图与观察到的视觉效果、在多变的执行结果下诊断失败，以及识别跨任务的重复性失败模式并将其转化为可复用的运行时更改。我们提出了GUI-HARVEST，一个自动框架优化器，能够在冻结骨干模型的情况下实现GUI智能体的自我改进。首先，为了将诊断建立在观察到的动作效果之上，它将模型输出和执行的动作与前后截图进行对齐，把发现与特定的界面转换关联起来。其次，为了考虑执行的可变性，它将同一任务的重复运行视为联合证据单元，利用……（摘要不完整）
tldr: GUI-HARVEST是一个自动框架优化器，通过将模型意图与前后截图对齐、将同一任务的重复运行作为联合证据来诊断失败，并将重复性失败模式转化为可复用的运行时更改，从而在冻结骨干模型的情况下实现GUI智能体的自我改进。
en_tdlr: GUI-HARVEST is an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models by aligning model intent with before-and-after screenshots, treating repeated runs as joint evidence for failure diagnosis, and translating recurrent failure patterns into reusable runtime changes.
